verses.verse:
अन्तः परिधिमानेन मुख रन्ध्ररूत्रयांशकः।
मानं तदेव छिद्राणाम् द्विस्वराणाम् प्रकल्पितम्।३३।
verses.text: By the measure of the inner circumference, the mouth-hole is one-third; the same measure is set for the holes that serve two notes.

commentary.text: The opening of the mukharandhra (mouth-hole) will be at most a tṛtīyāṃśa (one-third) of the paridhimāna (measure of the circumference). And the sizes of the dvisvara chidras (holes serving two notes) will also be the same or a little less.
